components.explanation: shaders/invulnerable_tint.gdshader, written by shuai-z: canvas_item, three uniforms (tint_amount driven by the game; tint_color and tint_strength set by the material only) and the colour line at line 8, which moves only COLOR.rgb toward the waystone's glow. project.godot names GL Compatibility, the renderer it runs in.

The hearts and what drives them: ui/hud.gd's _tint_hearts() sets tint_amount every frame to Rudy's _invulnerable_left / invulnerable_time; ui/hearts_tint.tres is the ShaderMaterial, local to the scene, on Hud/Hearts (ui/hud.tscn); ui/hearts.gd draws the heart art in ui/art/. content/rudy/rudy.gd owns the window and is unchanged byte for byte.

tests/invulnerable_tint_checks.gd/.tscn: 15 headless checks through real input at 30, 60 and 144 fps (uniforms, defaults, where the material is, begin, fade, end, duration, retrigger, time scale, pause, reload). tests/capture_tint.gd/.tscn: the windowed capture at controlled values, with the driver stopped.

excerpts.text:
## The hearts take on the lit waystone's glow while Rudy is invulnerable,
## fading with the time left (CHANGE-BRIEF.md). Reads his state, never sets it.
func _tint_hearts() -> void:
	(_hearts.material as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter(&"tint_amount", _rudy._invulnerable_left / _rudy.invulnerable_time)

for label: String in ["hit 1", "hit 2 (time scale 0.5)"]:
		var w: Dictionary = labelled[label]
		var expected := 71.0 / 60.0 if label == "hit 1" else 144.0 / 60.0
		var span := float(w.end - w.first) / _fps if not w.is_empty() and w.end >= 0 else INF
		spans_ok = spans_ok and absf(span - expected) <= 1.0 / _fps + EPS
		spans.append("%s %.4f s of real time, expected %.4f s ± %.4f" % [label, span, expected, 1.0 / _fps])
	_check("A9 the tint shows for 1.183 s ± one frame at time scale 1.0, and for 2.4 s of real time ± one frame at 0.5",
		spans_ok, ", ".join(spans))
